name: Alpha, Omega
source:
You play the role of a freshman about to enter a new chapter of his life at Stillwell Academy. The academy focusses on teaching students everything related to the world of sport, with a heavy biase towards the world of MMA.

[From [url=https://ezykeyal.itch.io/alpha-omega]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演的角色是一名即将在史迪威学院进入人生新篇章的新生。该学院专注于教授学生与体育世界相关的一切，并偏向综合格斗世界。

[来自[url=https://ezykeyal.itch.io/alpha-omega]Itch.io[/url]]
